name: Shouji Suzuka
source:
Shizuka's daughter, a petulant and provocative girl. She likes to show off to Seiichi in a sexual manner.

She harbors strong hostility toward Gozou, the village chief, but is unable to resist and opens herself up to him...

She despises Shizuka.

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/speed/inen/]official site[/url]]
